guidelines: A junior UI/UX Designer designing for mobile-first products used in Nigeria (small Android screens, slow networks). Automated contrast-check results are provided when available; use them rather than guessing colour values.

criteria.name: Visual hierarchy
criteria.description: The primary action and key information stand out; scanning order is clear.

criteria.name: Usability
criteria.description: Follows platform conventions, tap targets, clear labels, error and empty states considered.

criteria.name: Accessibility
criteria.description: Contrast (use the automated check), text size, not relying on colour alone.

criteria.name: Fit to the brief
criteria.description: Solves the stated user need within the constraints.

criteria.name: Flow completeness
criteria.description: Covers the happy path plus key alternate and error paths.

criteria.name: Friction and steps
criteria.description: Minimises steps and cognitive load; justifies each step.

criteria.name: User context
criteria.description: Accounts for the user's context (device, connectivity, trust).

criteria.name: Rationale quality
criteria.description: Decisions explained with principles or evidence.

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: Screens/flows requested are present and complete.

criteria.name: Handoff readiness
criteria.description: Specs, states and assets an engineer can build from.
